source.test: 5c. PROSE: the 5/3/1 scheme as bound to the squat slot (its waves are one positional table)

ret: Boring But Big: 5×10 on Barbell Back Squat at 50% of the squat slot's training max; three sets in deload weeks

Plan:
    - if this is a deload week: Barbell Back Squat: 5 sets of back-off 10 reps at 50% of the squat slot's training max, with 60% of the sets.
    - otherwise: Barbell Back Squat: 5 sets of back-off 10 reps at 50% of the squat slot's training max.
5/3/1 on Barbell Back Squat off your training max, with up to three jokers when the top set makes its reps, then 3–5 sets of 5 at the first-set weight

Plan: Barbell Back Squat: 1 set of 5/3/5 reps at 65/70/75% of your training max; 1 set of 5/3/3 reps at 75/80/85% of your training max; 1 set of as many reps as possible (at least 5/3/1 reps) at 85/90/95% of your training max; while the reps you actually did on “s3” is at least the reps prescribed for “s3” (no if unknown), up to 3 more sets of 1 rep at whichever is known first: (1) 105% of the load you actually did on “joker”; (2) 105% of the load you actually did on “s3”; 3 sets to 5 sets (your choice) of back-off 5 reps at the load prescribed for “s1” (slashed values step by training week, repeating).
